svg.title: M16-BY v2 Modern Mobile Game Direction Board
svg.desc: Repo-native documentation board for Talvori's Cozy Island Diorama Builder direction. It shows an island diorama, a build station at a slot, worker and companion presence, avoided patterns, and the next visual target.

g.text: A) Cozy Island Diorama Builder · chosen
B) Base Builder Tactical Map · structure only
C) Storybook Adventure Island · warmth only
No route · no BuildState · no assets · no persistence.
Code starts only after M16-BZ makes the flow visually concrete.
We build a world where language grows naturally.
Building creates context. Learning uses context.
